jade: Idea: add a 'cooldown hold' to autoswitch so we don't immediately flip to fallback on brief spikes. keep it simple?
mo: yes. short hold + sample checks sounds good. avoids churn.
frank: prefer samples over fixed time. e.g., require N failing windows within M seconds.
jade: lean proposal:
```
autoswitch:
  cooldown_ms: 15000
  min_fail_windows: 2
  window_ms: 5000
```
mo: UX: show a small orange badge 'cooldown' in the rollout timeline with hover explaining it. ops should see why we delayed.
ops-bot: [alert] 4367000455 - policy p-201 entered COOLDOWN due to error_ratio spike :information_source:
frank: telemetry: emit COOLDOWN_ENTER/EXIT events and metric cooldown_auto_defer_count. record decision payload for audit playback.
jade: agree. server-side guard: max cooldown 5m unless tenant flag.
mo: I'll wire the console snippet and a tiny e2e sim for spikes. frank, can you add telemetry proto?
frank: yes will add proto and unit tests.
jade: thanks all — will add to RFC and attach mock.
__note: Slack thread format: single string containing messages prefixed by sender. All top-level fields are strings or list of strings as required.
